summary: Founder's Access for Global MapleStory Classic World is now live!
body:
Founder's Access for Global MapleStory Classic World is now live! Players that have purchased Zakum or Orange Mushroom Founder's Packages can now take their first steps into MapleStory Classic World!

Create your Beginner character and level-up to follow the path of the Warrior, Magician, Bowman, or Thief. Explore Maple Island and Victoria Island, and join up with friends for a party quest. Check out the brand-new, exclusive Citizenship and Crafting systems! Learn more about Classic World in the Global MapleStory Classic World FAQ and start exploring the world and enjoying your character two weeks early.

Classic World will celebrate its Grand Launch on Wednesday, October 21, and Founder's Packages are still available to purchase or upgrade through October 14. Each Founder's Package includes a unique hat, effect, outfit set, and more!


All Founder's Package items can be fully equipped or used by both male and female characters of all jobs. Additionally, all items are purely cosmetic and do not grant any stats or bonuses.

Head to the Classic World Founder's Packages page for the full details. You have until 11:59 PM PDT on October 14 to purchase or upgrade yours! Items can be claimed via the mailbox from the start of Founder's Access through Monday, November 30 at 11:59 PM (UTC). Note that the Founder’s Package can only be claimed once per account on each platform (once on the Nexon website and once on Steam), and you will need to leave Maple Island before you can open your Founder’s Package items. After claiming your package, you will have 30 days to open your package.
name: Founder's Access Has Begun!
